description_expanded: Grayt Haven is brand new to our vacation rental management program. Hurry and secure your reservation now or check back soon for additional images and details! Now known as Grayt Haven —formerly Sea Prize —this stunning four-level retreat in the heart of Grayton Beach offers the perfect blend of coastal elegance and relaxed comfort. With 5 bedrooms, 4 full baths, and accommodations for up to 16 guests (2 Kings, 4 Queens, and 4 Twin bunks), this spacious home is designed for gathering. Just a short 1-minute walk to beach access (no road to cross), you’ll spend your days moving effortlessly between the sugar-white sand and your own private pool, all while enjoying glimpses of the sparkling Gulf from elevated balconies above. Inside, bright coastal finishes and warm wood flooring create an inviting, airy atmosphere. The main living level features an open-concept layout where the kitchen, dining, and living spaces flow together seamlessly—ideal for shared meals, movie nights, and easy conversation. The kitchen is thoughtfully appointed with stainless steel appliances, generous counter space, and seating that accommodates the whole group. The Primary King Suite is conveniently located on this level, offering privacy and comfort just steps from the heart of the home. Upstairs, additional guest rooms include a King suite, two Queen bedrooms with attached baths, and a cheerful bunk room perfect for younger guests or extra sleepers. The top level reveals a Gulf-view balcony and wet bar—an inviting setting for sunset cocktails and evening breezes. Outdoors, Grayt Haven truly shines. The private pool is surrounded by lounging space for soaking up the Florida sunshine, while covered balconies provide shaded retreats throughout the day. An outdoor shower makes rinsing off after beach time effortless, and the propane grill invites casual evening cookouts under the palms. Every level offers a place to gather—or slip away for a quiet moment with a morning coffee. Set in the heart of Grayton Beach , Grayt Haven places you within a 5-minute walk of some of 30A’s most beloved local favorites. Spend an evening at Red Bar , enjoy Gulf views and fresh coastal fare at Chiringo , or browse the curated style at Tribe Kelley Surf Post. Grayton Beach State Park is just minutes away, offering scenic trails, rare coastal dune lakes, and one of the most beautiful stretches of shoreline along the Gulf. Here, you’re close to the energy of town while still enjoying the privacy and comfort of your own coastal retreat. Beyond Grayton, the best of 30A is at your fingertips. Cruise east to Seaside for charming pastel cottages, open-air dining, and its iconic town square, or explore additional neighboring beach communities filled with boutiques, art galleries, and coastal cafés. Whether you’re beach hopping, paddleboarding on a dune lake, or catching live music under the stars, you’ll love returning to the comfort and privacy of Grayt Haven at the end of each sun-soaked day. First Floor: Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combo, Laundry. Second Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Dining, Kitchen, King Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo. Third Floor: King Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo, Bedroom with Two Queen Beds and Tub/Shower Combo, Bedroom with Two Queen Beds and Walk-In Shower, Bunk Room with Two Twin Bunks, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo. Fourth Floor: Bonus Den with Wet Bar *add $50.00 per day to heat the pool (available October - April if needed)
